facts.fact: Le360 reports that the DGSN's Mon identité numérique platform, in use since 2022, authenticates holders of the new NFC-chip CNIE and is integrated into the Epolice portal, where citizens sign in with their card number.

MAR.note: Nothing on civil register and ID exchange.

facts.fact: Le360 reports that the DGSN launched the Epolice portal in December 2024, on which citizens request and pay online for the anthropometric record, with over 5,000 requests processed by January 2025; further services are planned.

MAR.note: No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system itself.
No register keyed on the ID number is named.
No biometric check, certification or audit of the ID system is stated.

facts.fact: Le360 reports that the DGSN's own information systems directorate has digital, development, systems and security teams that run the Epolice platform.
Le360 reports that Epolice, built and run by DGSN's own teams with no contractor named, was launched in December 2024.
